title: Bounded `_flushQueue` admission
impact: Cap stream re-query admission at `ReaderPool.availableWorkerCount` per call so synchronous over-dispatch can no longer pile up against `_dispatchWaiters`. `dispatcherParkedTotal` drops from 3,590 → 0 (A11c overlap) and 1,198 → 0 (keyed-PK); `max_parked` 46 → 0. Release suite: 9 wins, 0 regressions, including neutral high-cardinality fan-out (the exp-100 killer)
